item.title: FloridaCommerce Reports Rise in Escambia County Unemployment
item.description: The Escambia County area unemployment rate increased, according to data released Friday by FloridaCommerce. The area’s unemployment rate was 5.2% in December 2025, a 0.4% increase from the November 2025 rate of 5.6%. A year ago, the unemployment rate in Escambia County was 3.4%.
